instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Egyptian life was centred around family units. Most families would live all together in small houses until the parents grew old. Then, the children would take care of them.

Compared to other ancient civilisations, Egyptian men and women were mostly equal. For example, women were allowed to run businesses and own property. Rich women might work as priestesses or musicians. However, they were still prevented from working in government.
Life was harder if you weren’t rich. For poor women, the main task was raising children, though some worked as servants or dancers. Poor men worked in physical jobs like farming or manual labour.
